tagline.en: The Blue Route and the Northeast Extension under one number
tagline.zh: 蓝线与东北延伸段，共用一个编号

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-95 at Ridley Township, Delaware County
start.zh: 特拉华县里德利镇，与 I-95 相接

end.en: I-81 near Clarks Summit, Lackawanna County
end.zh: 拉克万纳县克拉克斯萨米特附近，与 I-81 相接

en: I-476 is two unrelated roads that were given the same number in the 1990s. The southern twenty-one miles are the Mid-County Expressway, universally called the Blue Route, a free road running north from I-95 in Delaware County to the Pennsylvania Turnpike at Plymouth Meeting. Everything above that is the Turnpike's Northeast Extension, a tolled highway from 1957 that climbs out of the Philadelphia suburbs through the Lehigh Valley and the Poconos to I-81 near Scranton.

Together they add up to 131.5 miles, which by the FHWA's own table makes I-476 the longest three-digit Interstate in the country — longer than most two-digit routes in the eastern states. The southern half completed the ring of expressways around a city that never built a true beltway; the northern half is a rural toll road with a tunnel through Blue Mountain and long stretches where the traffic is trucks running between the Lehigh Valley warehouses and points north.
zh: I-476 其实是两条互不相干的路，在 1990 年代被安上了同一个编号。南段二十一英里是「中县快速路」，人人都叫它「蓝线」，是一条免费公路，自特拉华县的 I-95 向北通到普利茅斯会议镇的宾夕法尼亚收费高速。再往北的全部路段则是收费高速的东北延伸段，一条 1957 年就有的收费公路，从费城郊区一路爬升，穿过利哈伊谷与波科诺山区，抵达斯克兰顿附近的 I-81。
两段相加共 131.5 英里。按联邦公路管理局自己的表格，这使 I-476 成为全美最长的三位数州际公路——比东部不少两位数路线还长。南半段为一座从未真正修成环城高速的城市补上了快速路环；北半段则是一条乡村收费公路，有一条穿越蓝山的隧道，长段落里跑的都是往返于利哈伊谷仓储区与更北方向的卡车。

en: The Northeast Extension came first. The Turnpike Commission opened it in the 1950s as a toll road carrying the state route number 9, and its single-bore Lehigh Tunnel was a famous bottleneck that also kept the road below Interstate standard. A second bore was started on 14 February 1989 and finished on 22 November 1991, which made the toll road eligible for an Interstate number; AASHTO approved extending I-476 over it on 23 April 1995 and FHWA followed on 1 November 1996.

The Blue Route took thirty-five years and became, in the Philadelphia Inquirer's phrase, the most controversial highway in Pennsylvania. Three candidate alignments were drawn in different colours in the early 1960s and the blue one was chosen. Construction began in 1967 and then stalled in litigation brought by townships along the route; two isolated stretches built in 1970 sat closed because they connected to nothing. A three-mile piece opened in 1979, the segment from I-95 to MacDade Boulevard in 1988, and after a federal court dismissed the remaining cases on 1 May 1990 the road finally opened through on 19 December 1991. The connector to the Northeast Extension followed on 16 December 1992.
zh: 东北延伸段在先。收费高速管理局于 1950 年代把它建成收费公路，挂州道 9 号；其单孔的利哈伊隧道是有名的瓶颈，也使这条路达不到州际公路标准。第二孔隧道于 1989 年 2 月 14 日动工，1991 年 11 月 22 日完工，这条收费公路才具备了获得州际编号的条件；美国州公路与运输工作者协会于 1995 年 4 月 23 日批准把 I-476 延伸到这条路上，联邦公路管理局则在 1996 年 11 月 1 日批准。

蓝线修了三十五年，用《费城问询报》的话说，成了宾夕法尼亚州争议最大的一条公路。1960 年代初，三个候选线位分别用不同颜色画在图上，最后选中了蓝色的那条。工程 1967 年开工，随后因沿线各镇提起的诉讼陷入停滞；1970 年修好的两段孤立路基因为不连接任何道路而一直封闭。1979 年通车三英里，1988 年开通 I-95 至麦克戴德大道一段；联邦法院于 1990 年 5 月 1 日驳回其余诉讼后，全线终于在 1991 年 12 月 19 日贯通。通往东北延伸段的连接线则于 1992 年 12 月 16 日开通。

en: The Blue Route's final cost is usually given as $750 million for twenty-one and a half miles, a figure that reflects three decades of delay and an unusually expensive settlement with the communities in its path. Accounts differ on how to count it: one detailed roadway history puts the I-95-to-Chemical-Road section at $581.3 million, and the first short piece from I-95 to MacDade Boulevard, opened in 1988, at $28.2 million on its own.

What the money bought was as much mitigation as pavement. The 1985 settlement that unblocked the project forced a downsized design — four lanes rather than six along the southern half — plus depressed sections, extensive landscaping and noise walls. The two halves of I-476 are also paid for in completely different ways: the Blue Route is a free state highway maintained by PennDOT, while the Northeast Extension is a toll road whose users still pay at the barrier.
zh: 蓝线的最终造价通常被记作二十一英里半花费 7.5 亿美元，这个数字反映的是三十年的拖延，以及与沿线社区之间一份代价异常高昂的和解。不同记述的算法并不一致：一部详尽的公路史把 I-95 至 Chemical Road 一段记为 5.813 亿美元，而 1988 年开通的 I-95 至麦克戴德大道那一小段单独为 2,820 万美元。
这些钱买到的，缓解措施与路面几乎各占一半。1985 年那份让工程解套的和解协议，迫使设计缩水——南半段由六车道改为四车道——并追加了下沉路段、大量绿化与隔音墙。I-476 的两半在出资方式上也完全不同：蓝线是由宾州交通部养护的免费州级公路，东北延伸段则是收费公路，使用者至今仍要在收费站付费。

value.en: 131.5 miles, entirely in Pennsylvania — the longest three-digit Interstate in the system
value.zh: 131.5 英里，全线位于宾夕法尼亚州，为全系统最长的三位数州际公路

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

value.zh: 21.5 英里共 7.5 亿美元，1991 年通车

value.zh: I-95 至麦克戴德大道之间 0.7 英里，造价 2,820 万美元，1988 年 8 月 17 日通车

figures.source: AARoads route guide to I-476 in Pennsylvania, citing PennDOT records

why.en: The Northeast Extension was built by the Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission in the 1950s and financed with revenue bonds rather than highway appropriations; no construction total for the original toll road was located in a primary source this session.
why.zh: 东北延伸段由宾夕法尼亚收费高速管理局于 1950 年代修建，资金来自收益债券而非公路拨款；本次查证未能在一手资料中找到这条收费公路最初的建设总额。

timeline.en: The first three miles of the Blue Route open between I-76 and Chemical Road.
timeline.zh: 蓝线首通三英里，位于 I-76 与 Chemical Road 之间。

timeline.en: The Blue Route opens through to I-95 after 24 years of construction and litigation.
timeline.zh: 历经 24 年施工与诉讼，蓝线全线贯通至 I-95。

timeline.en: The second bore of the Lehigh Tunnel is completed, removing the last barrier to an Interstate number.
timeline.zh: 利哈伊隧道第二孔完工，取得州际编号的最后障碍被清除。

timeline.en: FHWA approves extending I-476 over the Northeast Extension, creating a single 131-mile route.
timeline.zh: 联邦公路管理局批准将 I-476 延伸至东北延伸段，形成一条 131 英里的完整路线。
